🧠 Learning

Neural network

In simple words

An AI model made of many simple connected units (neurons), arranged in layers, that learn patterns together.

A type of AI model loosely inspired by the brain: many simple connected units (neurons), arranged in layers, pass numbers to each other and together learn to spot patterns.

Example. The neural network in a photo app can learn to tell dogs from cats after seeing lots of labelled pictures of both.

Lessons that teach it

  • Lesson 3: Neural Networks

Related words

  • Artificial neuronThe tiny building block of a neural network: it weighs its input numbers, adds them up and passes a signal on.
  • Deep learningMachine learning with neural networks that have many layers.
  • TransformerA neural network design from 2017 that uses attention to work out how the words of a text relate.
  • Convolutional neural network (CNN)A neural network for pictures whose layers use convolutions to find patterns, from edges up to whole objects.
  • BackpropagationThe method a neural network uses to work out how much each weight was to blame for a mistake.
  • Black boxA system whose inner workings are hard to see or explain, even for the people who built it.
